To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the dynamic model of one DOF Pneumatic muscle actuators was created, 2) this model was validated using simulation results, and 3) the model can be used as a reference model in hybrid adaptive fuzzy control system.
The proposed hybrid fuzzy adaptive controller is able to control the nonlinear pneumatic muscle actuation system in a satisfactory manner.
The proposed hybrid fuzzy adaptive controller is capable of handling the nonlinear properties of Pneumatic Muscle Actuator.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a hybrid adaptive fuzzy controller with a reference model for pneumatic muscle actuation systems.
design of a reference model for hybrid fuzzy adaptive controller of one-DOFs muscle actuator.
the design of the reference model for hybrid adaptive controller of pneumatic muscle actuators.
